title: Laser eye surgery
what: A laser changes the shape of the cornea, the clear front part of the eye. After this, you can see clearly without glasses or contact lenses.
why: For nearsightedness, farsightedness, and astigmatism, when you want to do without glasses. It is not right for everyone. The doctor decides after an eye exam.
duration: usually 15 to 30 minutes for both eyes; the laser works for less than a minute
tell_doctor: Which contact lenses you wear and for how long
All your medicines and health conditions, especially diabetes and connective tissue diseases
If you have had eye injuries or eye surgery
If you are pregnant or breastfeeding

prepare.title: Eye exam
prepare.text: Before surgery you have a detailed eye check. It shows whether correction is possible and which method suits you.

prepare.title: Contact lenses
prepare.text: Stop wearing lenses ahead of time: soft ones usually 1 to 2 weeks before, hard ones longer. Your clinic will tell you exactly.

prepare.title: On the day
prepare.text: No makeup, face cream, or perfume. You can have breakfast as usual, unless your clinic says otherwise.

prepare.title: Getting home
prepare.text: You cannot drive after surgery. Arrange for someone to take you home.

steps: Numbing drops are put in your eyes
Your eyelids are gently held open so you do not blink
A ring is placed on the eye. For a few seconds your vision goes dark
You look at a blinking point of light
The laser works for a few seconds
The eye is rinsed and drops are put in. Then the same is done for the other eye
feel: Usually no pain, only pressure on the eye
You may hear the laser click or notice a smell. This is normal
For a few hours after surgery: burning, tears, and a feeling of sand in the eyes
after: Your vision is blurry at first, and usually much better by the next day
Do not rub your eyes. Sometimes you wear a protective shield at night
Use your eye drops exactly as the doctor says
A check-up is usually the next day
For about 1 to 2 weeks, no makeup, swimming pool, or sauna. The doctor will give you the exact time
red_flags: Strong eye pain, or pain that keeps getting worse
Your vision suddenly gets much worse
The eye becomes very red, or there is discharge like pus
A blow or injury to the eye

faq.a: Usually not. The eye is numbed with drops. You feel pressure, and afterwards burning for a few hours.

faq.q: When can I go back to computer work?
faq.a: Usually after a few days, but it depends on the method. Your doctor will tell you exactly.

faq.q: Can my vision get worse again?
faq.a: Sometimes vision changes a little over time. Resting your eyes and regular eye check-ups help keep the result.

reminders.text: Laser eye surgery in one week. Check with your clinic when to stop wearing contact lenses.
Laser eye surgery tomorrow. No makeup or face cream. Arrange for someone to take you home.
